basis: MYB-related master activator of BETL genes, BETL-specific in situ (Gomez et al. 2002 Plant Cell); in situ and DE outer BETL c2 only, pct 0.45 vs 0.015 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 6.3x over PC in Visium but low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Sparse detection: use with BETL9/BAP2. LCM BETL 87x over PC at 8 DAP; MRP1 binds its BETL target promoters in Y1H (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

Imprinted cysteine-rich peptide required for BETL differentiation (Costa et al. 2012 Curr Biol); DE c2/c9 0.59 vs 0.07 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 14x over PC in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Yuan SD27 full name 'maternally expressed gene6' is a typo; UniProt Q6JB15 = MEG1. In situ + promoter BETL (Gutierrez-Marcos et al. 2004 Plant Cell); LCM BETL 24x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

MYB-related TF; mybr29 mutant BETL has fewer wall ingrowths and small seeds (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 7); DE outer BETL c2 0.77 vs 0.04; BETL 9.3x over PC in Visium, low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). NCBI: KUA1-like. In situ BETL-only at 6 DAP (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4B,F); LCM BETL 174x over PC (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

Hexose SWEET needed for hexose transport across the BETL; sweet4c mutant has defective BETL and small seeds (Sosso et al. 2015 Nat Genet); DE c2 0.60 vs 0.19 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 4.5x over EAS in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). No v5 xref in MaizeGDB crosswalk; v5 ID = Ensembl gene at the NCBI v5 locus of LOC100273706 (chr5:130.30 Mb). In situ BETL-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5).

BETL cell-wall invertase; mn1 mutant has miniature seeds and BETL defects (Cheng et al. 1996 Plant Cell); BETL 9.9x in Visium and LCM agreement (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Not DE in the 6-7 DAP scRNA (Yuan 2024): expect weak signal before ~8 DAP. LCM BETL CS 0.95, 22x over PED at 8 DAP (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell): BETL-specific by 8 DAP.

BETL-specific LTP-like protein (MRP1 target); in situ BETL in two studies (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6; Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Table S3); DE c2/c9 0.70 vs 0.07; BETL 12.2x in Visium. Fu Methods truncate the ID as Zm00001d04182. In situ BETL again in Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell and Royo et al. 2014 Front Plant Sci; LCM only 3.9x over CZ (BETL-to-CZ gradient).

Basal layer antifungal protein secreted into maternal tissue; in situ BETL (Serna et al. 2001 Plant J; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6); DE c2/c9 0.95 vs 0.13; BETL 12.9x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). LCM BETL 9.4x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

Type-A response regulator specific to transfer cells, in situ (Muniz et al. 2006 Plant J); DE outer BETL c2 only, 0.45 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 8.7x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). LCM BETL 163x over PC (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

RAISED medium->high (2026-10-20): in situ BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5), independent of Yuan/Fu; LCM BETL 16x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Also marks the BIZ. BETL gene family member (NCBI betl10, knottin/defensin-like); DE c2/c9 0.85 vs 0.09 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun) and BETL 10.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). No in situ in Yuan or Fu.
Uncharacterized nsLTP; in situ BETL (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE c2/c9 0.98 vs 0.29 (broad background); top BETL gene in Visium, 9.3x (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

Uncharacterized knottin/LCR70-like (Yuan symbol 1d053785); in situ BETL and reduced in mybr29 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 7f); DE c2/c9 0.99 vs 0.40; BETL 12.3x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

Uncharacterized (Yuan symbol 1d053108); in situ outer BETL (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 1e, 2g), DE c2 log2FC 4.6, 0.96 vs 0.15; BETL 14.2x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Outer-layer (c2) bias. In situ BETL again (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Table 6), LCM 35x over CZ.

RAISED medium->high and expression->characterized_enriched (2026-10-20): in situ BETL (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Table 6), LCM 28x over ESR. Uncharacterized nsLTP; DE outer BETL c2 log2FC 4.4, 0.97 vs 0.10 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 6.3x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Two independent enrichments plus in situ.

Small cysteine-rich BETL protein; in situ BETL (Hueros et al. 1999 Plant Physiol; Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2u); BETL 10.9x in Visium. Not DE in Yuan 2024 at 6-7 DAP: strong from ~8 DAP. LCM BETL 36x over CZ at 8 DAP (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

Basal layer antifungal peptide (UniProt Q9FER2); in situ BETL (Serna et al. 2001 Plant J; Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) and BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM BETL 21x over CZ. NO v4 MODEL (alt_id empty): absent from v4-annotated data, so not in Yuan or Fu.

MEG-family cysteine-rich peptide; in situ BETL (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Table 6), LCM 14x over CZ; DE Yuan c2/c9 0.59/0.66 vs 0.07 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun SD4); Fu BETL 15.2 vs ESR 1.3 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

Uncharacterized; in situ BETL (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell; graded expression there, characterized_enriched here as for other in situ-validated uncharacterized genes), LCM 75x over ESR; DE Yuan c2/c9 0.91 vs 0.10 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); Fu BETL 118 vs PC 14 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

BURP-domain protein (UniProt A0A096QAE9 names it BURP7: compare by ID); in situ BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); DE Yuan c2 0.45 vs 0.04, c9 0.43 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); Fu BETL 12.1x. LCM BETL only 2.3x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell): basal-gradient gene, also BIZ.

Uncharacterized LTP/seed-storage-domain protein (UniProt K7U9P3); in situ BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); Fu BETL 75 vs PC 5 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1); LCM BETL 14x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Not DE in Yuan 2024.

MEG-family peptide (UniProt Q6JB14 MEG2; Zhan DS3 calls the v3 gene MEG9: compare by ID); in situ BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4D,H); LCM BETL 8.3x over CZ (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell, same lab). NO v4 MODEL (alt_id empty).
Uncharacterized (UniProt B6UI21), adjacent to BAP2; in situ BETL+BIZ (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM BETL 58x (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell, same lab). NO v4 MODEL (alt_id empty).
Uncharacterized LTP-domain protein (UniProt A0A804MUH8); in situ BETL-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM BETL 67x (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell, same lab). NO v4 MODEL (alt_id empty).

Uncharacterized BURP-domain protein (UniProt A0A804UCM9); the only BIZ-exclusive in situ gene, 8 DAP (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4C,G). Low expression: LCM BETL 12.6 / CZ 4.4 FPKM (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell has no BIZ capture); Fu basal BETL spots 5.5 vs PC 0.4; not DE in Yuan 2024. Call BIZ as BURP+ with BETL+BIZ genes (BETL10, BURP3, BAP1A, MEG2) but without outer-BETL genes (MRP1, TCRR1, MYBR29, gpm481).

PLATZ12 TF; in situ CZ-only at 7 DAP, diffuse (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4I); LCM CZ highest (3808 FPKM) but CSE 1145 and ESR 1006 (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); Fu CZ 1.3x. Stage-restricted (6-8 DAP); later starchy-endosperm-wide (see the Starchy_Endosperm row).
LCM CZ only (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell): CS 0.76, 4.2x over CSE. Fu SCU 7.0 > EAS 5.1 (not CZ); not DE in Yuan 2024.
LCM CZ only (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell): 5.1x over PED. Yuan DE mostly in the stress cluster c13 (0.68 vs 0.24): probably a stress-responsive gene. Fu near zero.

CLE-family ESR peptide, in situ ESR (Opsahl-Ferstad et al. 1997 Plant J); DE c15 log2FC 6.9, 0.88 vs 0.01 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); ESR 14.8x in Visium, low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). NO B73 v5 GENE MODEL (no crosswalk entry; Ensembl v5 has no gene at NCBI LOC100037781, chr1:14.37 Mb): ref_gene holds the v4 ID and will not match v5 data. In situ ESR (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM ESR 77x over PE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

CLE-family ESR peptide, in situ ESR (Opsahl-Ferstad et al. 1997 Plant J); DE c15 log2FC 8.0, 0.92 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); ESR 5.3x in Visium, some BETL (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). NCBI aliases of this locus include ESR1/ZmESR1: compare by ID, not symbol. In situ ESR (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM ESR 199x over PE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell).

Defensin of the ESR, in situ (Balandin et al. 2005 Plant Mol Biol); DE c15 0.82 vs 0.005 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); ESR top in Visium but BETL 7.6 vs ESR 13.6 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun): expect some BETL signal. LCM ESR 182x over PE at 8 DAP (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Antimicrobial activity in vitro; protein later in placento-chalaza (Balandin 2005, characterized survey grades it function medium; kept characterized_enriched here because defence does not define ESR identity).

MEG1-like imprinted cysteine-rich peptide; in situ ESR (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 1e), DE c15 log2FC 7.8, 0.94 vs 0.06; ESR 3.7x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). NO B73 v5 GENE MODEL (no crosswalk entry; no Ensembl v5 gene at NCBI LOC103632061, chr7:13.50 Mb): ref_gene holds the v4 ID.

Uncharacterized knottin (Yuan symbol 1d038758); in situ ESR (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE c15 0.77 vs 0.01; ESR 5.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Not in NCBI Gene; ID from the papers' tables.

Uncharacterized; in situ ESR (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Fig 7O), LCM 155x over PE; DE Yuan c15 0.85 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); Fu ESR 11.2 vs BETL 1.8 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
Transmembrane protein (UniProt B6SYN6); strong in situ ESR-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4J); LCM ESR 133x over PE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell, same lab). NO v4 MODEL (alt_id empty).

SWEET sugar transporter; in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6, 'EAS progenitors'); EAS 12x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Not DE in Yuan SD4 (EAS forms after 7 DAP).
PEBP/FT-like (Yuan symbol PEBP11); in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell); EAS 9.9x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Not DE in Yuan 2024 at 6-7 DAP.
Hexose SWEET; in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell); EAS 11x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S12). Not DE in Yuan 2024 at 6-7 DAP.

Beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase Male sterile8; in situ EAS progenitors (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 1e); EAS 5.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). CONFLICT: Yuan SD4 lists it as DE only in ESR c15 (0.37 vs 0.015), not EAS c11; may mark the embryo-facing endosperm in general.
P-type Cu ATPase; in situ EAS (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2k); EAS 5.6x in Visium. Single study; not DE in Yuan 2024.

NAC TF (ZmNAC36) driving lytic cell death and corpse clearance in the EAS, EAS-specific in snRNA (Doll et al. 2025 Plant Cell; characterized survey, function medium); Fu EAS top 1.6 vs BETL 0.2 at low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1): raised medium->high by agreement. EAS forms after 7 DAP; not DE in Yuan.

NAC TF (ZmNAC65) redundant with KIL1 for EAS cell death, EAS-specific in snRNA (Doll et al. 2025 Plant Cell; characterized survey, function medium); Fu EAS top 0.9 vs BETL 0.1 at low counts: raised medium->high by agreement.

RAISED medium->high (2026-10-20): second independent in situ in the aleurone (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Table 6), LCM AL 10.2x over ESR at 8 DAP. Subtilisin-like protease; in situ outer layer (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 1e, Supp Fig 6); DE AL c4/c3/c0 0.82 vs 0.39 (modest). Near zero in 12-24 DAP Visium (Fu et al. 2023): early-aleurone marker.

Terpene synthase 11 (UniProt Q1EG72); in situ outer layer (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6) but not DE in SD4; absent from Visium. v4 maps to three v5 models (Zm00001eb412960/412970/412980); first listed.
Non-specific lipid-transfer protein 2 (UniProt P83506); in situ aleurone (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2w); 4.4x over pericarp in Visium. Not DE in Yuan 2024 (6-7 DAP): later-stage marker.

Classic aleurone cDNA (5a2/AL-9, UniProt B4FFB8). CONFLICT: non-specific in Yuan et al. 2024 scRNA (pct 0.999 vs 0.931) and ESR nearly as high as AL in Visium, 44 vs 62 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). v4 maps to two v5 models (369440 carries B4FFB8, also 369450). In situ AL-only at 8 DAP (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4A,E) but LCM AL only 2x over ESR, also high in BETL and NU (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Not raised: Yuan and Fu contradict.

RAISED low->medium (2026-10-20): in situ partial aleurone fate (Wisniewski and Rogowsky 2004 Plant Mol Biol) and LCM AL 3.4x over NU (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Not higher: enrichment modest in all three datasets. Vacuolar H+-pyrophosphatase; weak AL DE (0.72 vs 0.38; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun) and AL 5x at low counts in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD4 AL). Symbol conflict: Yuan SD27 'VPP7', NCBI LOC542328 'vacuolar proton pump homolog 1 (vpp1)'.

nsLTP; Fu's aleurone-vs-pericarp gate gene, AL 5.0x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun); DE in Yuan AL c0/c3/c4 0.77 vs 0.38 but also top DE in nucellus c14 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). Not aleurone-exclusive.

Phosphoethanolamine N-methyltransferase; in situ aleurone (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell Supp Table 6), LCM CS 0.94, 15.6x over ESR; weak DE Yuan AL c3/c4 0.50 vs 0.28, also embryo c17 0.71 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: Fu 12-24 DAP has it in ESR (24.1) and near zero in AL. Not raised.

Uncharacterized; in situ aleurone (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell), LCM 7.5x over CSE; DE Yuan AL c0/c3/c4 0.71 vs 0.26 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun): cross-study, so high. Near zero in Fu 12-24 DAP: early-aleurone marker like SBT1.

Imprinted PLATZ TF (ZmPLATZ12) required for storage-reserve accumulation, fl3 mutant (Li et al. 2017 Plant Cell); in situ SE and DE c11/c8/c1 0.82 vs 0.22 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); highest in CZ/VE/SE but only 1.3x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Basal bias in both. UniProt names the v5 model PLTZ2; NCBI alias fl3 confirms the ID. STAGE CONFLICT: in situ CZ-only at 7 DAP (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4I); LCM CZ 3808 FPKM but CSE 1145 and ESR 1006 (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell; also their single CZ in situ gene). At 6-8 DAP read it as basal/CZ-biased; see the Conducting_Zone row.

Endosperm auxin-biosynthesis flavin monooxygenase (de18 mutant); in situ SE (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE basal SE c8 0.39 vs 0.08; flat and low in Visium (Fu et al. 2023). Graded characterized_enriched (review said function): auxin synthesis does not define SE identity.

Cytokinin N-glucosyltransferase (uncharacterized in NCBI); in situ basal SE (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 11), DE c8 0.76 vs 0.22. Flat in 12-24 DAP Visium (Fu et al. 2023). Basal SE position near BETL/BIZ.
Early nodulin-93-like (Yuan symbol 1d045392); in situ outer SE (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 2i), DE c1 0.43 vs 0.11. Flat in Visium (Fu et al. 2023). Position within SE, not a separate type.
Pyruvate decarboxylase 1, hypoxia-induced; in situ outer SE (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 2i) but broad (c1 0.91 vs 0.61). Marks a hypoxic state of SE, not identity.

Pyruvate orthophosphate dikinase 1 (cyPPDK); in situ basal SE (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 2i), not DE in SD4; endosperm-wide 1.2x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023). Same locus is the C4 leaf mesophyll PPDK: do not use outside endosperm.

Tryptophan aminotransferase-related (NCBI alias TA1); DE c8/c1 0.87 vs 0.58 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); endosperm-wide in Visium, AL highest (Fu et al. 2023). Weak. In situ SE+CZ at 10 DAP (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4M). Kept low.

RAISED low->medium (2026-10-20): in situ SE-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); LCM CSE 1.9x (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell; DS3 TF annotation ZmNAC130 confirms the symbol). Not higher: about 2x enrichment everywhere. Endosperm NAC TF (Yuan symbol NACTF130; NCBI LOC606433 'NAC domain-containing protein 100', alias nac4); DE c11/c15/c8 0.63 vs 0.25 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); SE 1.2x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 SD4 SE). ID from Yuan SD27.

Storage protein; in situ SE (Woo et al. 2001 Plant Cell, as cited by Zhan 2015); LCM CSE 24x over CZ at 8 DAP (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); Fu VE 772 > SE 505 (peripheral SE highest). Not DE in Yuan at 6-7 DAP. Very high ambient-RNA risk in later-stage data. Matches the maize_seed draft (function high).

Sucrose synthase shrunken1; in situ SE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell), LCM CSE 8.8x over EMB; Fu SE 67.6 vs VE 36 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Not DE in Yuan 2024. Medium as in the maize_seed draft: broad endosperm metabolic gene with onset near 8 DAP.
AGPase large subunit shrunken2; in situ SE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) but LCM only 3.1x over CZ; Fu SE 29 vs VE 17.6. Not DE in Yuan 2024. Endosperm-wide starch gene.
NAC TF (UniProt A0A060D1R6); in situ SE-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5); not SE-specific in Fu (BETL 7.6, CZ 6.8); not DE in Yuan 2024; not compartment-specific in Zhan 2015.

GRAS TF (Zhan DS3: ZmGRAS20/SCL1); in situ SE at 10 DAP, strongest under the aleurone (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 4N,O; position read from the image); LCM CSE 2.4x (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). Fu AL 3.5 > VE 2.3 > SE: may mark peripheral/subaleurone SE.

MYB TF (UniProt calls it MYB44); in situ SE-only (Li et al. 2014 PNAS Fig 5, name assigned there by elimination; Zhan 2015 DS3 TF annotation of GRMZM2G369799 = ZmMYB127 confirms it); LCM CSE 4.3x (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell, same lab); Fu low (VE 0.8, SE 0.6).

Mitotic B-type cyclin (NCBI 'cyclin IaZm'; Yuan symbol CYC7); DE G2/M c10 0.46 vs 0.15 and c12 0.65 vs 0.15 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); dividing clusters in embryo (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun) and shoot apex (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

Cytokinesis syntaxin (G2/M); DE c12 0.35 vs 0.04 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); dividing clusters in Wu et al. 2025 and Satterlee et al. 2020. v4 maps to two v5 models; 215350 per the maize_embryo ID check.

Centromeric histone H3 (UniProt Q8LK76); DE c12 0.64 vs 0.28 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); dividing clusters in Wu et al. 2025 and Satterlee et al. 2020. v4 maps to two v5 models; 291210 per the maize_embryo ID check.
Cyclin 3 (NCBI LOC542305); DE c10 0.50 vs 0.11 and c12 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); conserved grass-root Dividing_cells marker (Guillotin et al. 2023).
HMG-box TF (NCBI alias HMG5; Yuan symbol HMG9); DE c10 0.65 vs 0.17 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun) but in situ broad across types; also a Guillotin et al. 2023 grass-root Dividing_cells marker.
Small heat-shock protein; top DE of the removed stimulus-response cluster c13, 0.88 vs 0.15 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). Dissociation/heat state; flag, do not annotate as a type.

RAISED medium->high (2026-10-20): LCM nucellus 19x over PE (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell; single replicate, different lab from Yuan). Uncharacterized; in situ nucellus (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE c14 0.62 vs 0.003. Maternal contaminant of dissected endosperm; pericarp not excluded. Not nucellus-resolved in Fu 2023.
Beta-expansin (UniProt expansin-B family); LCM NU 167x over PE, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); not DE in Yuan nucellus c14; Fu PE 1.4 (low).
MADS-box TF (UniProt Q9AR51); LCM NU 10x over ESR, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only.
LCM NU 92x over PE, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only.

Lipid transfer protein 3 (NCBI alias LTP3; Yuan symbol PLT3); DE embryo-contaminant c17 0.38 vs 0.05 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); in situ embryo axis, 4.2x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2o). Raised low->medium by agreement, not to high: it is an epidermis/protoderm gene (maize_leaf draft Epidermis row), so it marks embryo protoderm, not all embryo cells. Use only to flag embryo contamination.

Acanthoscurrin-like glycine-rich protein; DE embryo-contaminant c17 log2FC 9.1, 0.99 vs 0.003 with tandem paralogs 1d011342/1d011345 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: Fu et al. 2023 call it an ESR marker (84x in 55 um Visium spots that border the embryo). Check against ESR1/ESR2 before use.

NF-YB embryo-identity TF (UniProt Q94EJ7; function from the Arabidopsis ortholog); LCM EMB 145x over ESR (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only; not DE in Yuan 2024; absent in Fu. Flags embryo contamination.
YABBY TF; LCM EMB 205x over NU (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only; not in Yuan or Fu.

LCM EMB 703x over ESR (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); DE Yuan embryo-contaminant c17 0.54 vs 0.00 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun): raised low->medium by agreement. Fu has it in ESR spots (8.7 vs EM 2.8), the same embryo-border pattern as EAG1b.
DROOPING LEAF YABBY TF (carpel identity in rice); LCM PE 187x over NU, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); Fu PE top, 0.8 vs PC 0.1 at low counts: raised low->medium by agreement.
DROOPING LEAF-like YABBY TF; LCM PE 208x over ESR, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); Fu PE 0.2 (barely detected).
Alpha-expansin (UniProt Q94KT5); LCM PE >1000x, single replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell); 0 in Fu 12-24 DAP: early pericarp only.
LCM PC 764x over PED, single low-RIN replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell). CONFLICT: Yuan DE in aleurone c0 (0.46 vs 0.12); Fu near zero.
GA-regulated GASA family; LCM PC 226x over PED, single low-RIN replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only.
Uncharacterized; LCM PC 208x over PED, single low-RIN replicate (Zhan et al. 2015 Plant Cell) only.
